description: This file contains localization settings for the FullCalendar library, providing Arabic-Tunisian language and regional configurations such as month names, weekday names, date formats, calendar labels, and relative time expressions.

methods.name: defineLocale
methods.description: Defines a new locale for Moment.js with the provided localization strings.

methods.name: lang
methods.description: Adds or modifies language locales in Moment.js.

methods.name: datepickerLang
methods.description: Sets language parameters for the jQuery UI Datepicker, including month names, day names, and date format.

methods.name: fullCalendar
methods.description: Main object for FullCalendar configuration, with localization and language support methods.
